question: On a Free Octoparse account, does the MCP/API template allowance reset weekly or monthly, and do a Free API key and Free local runs work through the AgentTools REST API and the CLI?
why: Weekly: the help center article, the April 24, 2026 release notes, the pricing blog and the MCP landing page, and the MCP docs page in its copy archived on 2026-09-13. Monthly: the MCP docs page in its current text (2,000 records a month), and the AI recipes README and skill (a monthly row quota shared by MCP and CLI template runs on Free) in a repository first committed on 2026-10-21; one blog table also gives 2,000 records/day. No changelog entry records a change, and the help center states the free trial credits are not displayed on the account page, so only a quota error from the MCP server or a usage view on a Free account can settle the period. The CLI page says the CLI is free and needs an account and an API key, while the pricing table lists API access as unavailable on Free and the OpenAPI reference needs Standard or higher; whether a Free key reaches the AgentTools endpoints and whether the Free plan accepts CLI local runs of custom tasks are unverified: behind a sign-up. An operator step on a Free account.
